text:
Noah Kim: Hey all, day 1 and stuck on Console access. After SSO I can open the UI but Feature Flags shows an empty list and network logs a 403 to /api/flags.
Noah Kim: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags -> {"error":"forbidden","message":"role_missing"}. Do new hires get a service account or a role?
Riley (Infra): Welcome Noah! :wave: New hires get a console-read role via JIT. Service accounts are for automation only. Drop your SSO email and I'll create the request.
Noah Kim: noah.kim@redwood.ai. Thanks.
Access Bot: Access request created: ONB-5581 by Riley (Infra). Approvers: eng-leads. Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/ONB-5581
Riley (Infra): Approved the JIT. Try refreshing the page. If the flags API still 403, run `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags 2>&1 | grep x-request-id` and paste the id.
Noah Kim: x-request-id: rq_b12c4f. Flags still 403 for prod, staging ok.
Zoe (DevEx): Hi Noah  If you need to demo flipping a flag for your intro I can grant a temp ff-operator for 15m. DM me the flag key.
Ivy (Security): FYI prod has an IP allowlist on some admin endpoints. If JIT doesn't fix it include your public IP in ONB-5581 and we'll open a short window. Read-only service accounts auto-approve for 90 days; write scopes need review.
Riley (Infra): Quick workaround: SSH tunnel through bastion -> `ssh -NL 8000:console.internal:443 riley@bastion` then open https://localhost:8000 and re-login. I'm enabling a temporary allowlist for Noah's IP now.
Noah Kim: Tunnel worked, UI loads and prod flags visible after the allowlist. Thanks everyone, will file a follow-up if I need a short-lived service account for CI.
Ivy (Security): Note: include justification and expiry if requesting a service account. Default read-only expiry is 90 days.
Noah Kim: Closing loop  thanks :thumbsup:
